::: {.page-header}
# Join the Movement
:::

::: {.feature-block}
## Tell Us Why You Want to Join

Fill out the form below and let us know how you'd like to get involved. Oluwadamilola and the ODA team will personally follow up with you.

<div class="contact-form">
<form action="https://formspree.io/f/xpqvbeew" method="POST">
  <label for="name">Full Name</label>
  <input type="text" id="name" name="name" required>

  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input type="email" id="email" name="email" required>

  <label for="phone">Phone Number</label>
  <input type="tel" id="phone" name="phone">

  <label for="interest">How would you like to help?</label>
  <select id="interest" name="interest" style="width:100%; padding:0.7rem; margin-bottom:1rem; border:1px solid #ccc; border-radius:5px;">
    <option value="Community outreach">Community outreach</option>
    <option value="Event support">Event support</option>
    <option value="Social media / spreading the word">Social media / spreading the word</option>
    <option value="Other">Other</option>
  </select>

  <label for="reason">Why do you want to join ODA?</label>
  <textarea id="reason" name="reason" rows="5" required></textarea>

  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>
</div>

:::
